description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for performing CRUD operations on Task entities in a Room database for an Android application.

classes.name: TaskDao
classes.description: DAO interface for accessing Task data, providing methods for retrieval, insertion, update, and deletion.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all tasks, ordered by completion status, due date, and update time.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Task by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Task into the database with conflict strategy to replace existing entries.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Task in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a specified Task from the database.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all Tasks from the database.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of Tasks in the database.
